name: appium-wdio-android
description: Android mobile automation with WebdriverIO + Appium

scripts.postinstall: npm run appium:driver || echo "uiautomator2 driver install skipped"
scripts.test:android: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:realme: npm run clean:reports && cross-env RUN_ON_REAL_DEVICE=true wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:bs: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.browserstack.conf.js
